description: App Store & Google Play keyword ranks, rivals, store pages, reviews, charts and AI visibility as an MCP server. The remote server is included on every Storelift plan, including Free.
author: Vomcore

tool_signatures.name: get_ai_visibility
tool_signatures.description: Whether AI assistants name this app when asked natural questions about its category — reported per engine (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini), never averaged. This is an OBSERVATION, not a ranking: a model

tool_signatures.name: get_charts
tool_signatures.description: App Store chart position for one country: current ranks per list (free / paid / grossing, overall and in category) plus their history. Google Play is absent on purpose — Google publishes no chart list, so there is nothing to read, and a number here would be invented.

tool_signatures.name: get_history
tool_signatures.description: Keyword rank history for one country. Series points are [day, rank]; a null rank means the app was absent from the top results that day, which is not the same as a bad rank.

tool_signatures.name: get_keywords
tool_signatures.description: Keyword ranks for one app in one App Store / Google Play country. THREE STATES ARE DISTINCT: measured=false means the query could not be measured, rank=null means it was measured but the app is absent from the top results, rank=<number> is the rank. Never collapse them into one — counting an unmeasured day as zero produces a false answer.

tool_signatures.name: get_reviews
tool_signatures.description: Recent reviews for one country:

tool_signatures.name: get_rivals
tool_signatures.description: Apps that rank ABOVE this app in search. For each rival you get the keywords it beats you on, its rank there (theirRank) and yours (ourRank) — ourRank null means the app does not appear for that keyword at all.
